meta.frame: site east/north/up (m), origin at the site's ground; body frame MEAN_ME

terrain.source: NASA LRO LOLA GDR polar DEMs (PDS, imbrium.mit.edu)
files: NASA PGDA shape-from-shading model, 5 m/px (LROC NAC photographs on LOLA; Bertone et al. 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17954508), +-7.5 km around the site
terrain.note_5m: SfS model: terrain detail from LROC NAC photographs where the ground is sunlit in them; LOLA elsewhere

ephemeris.observer: site on the Moon (coord@301, geodetic, MEAN_ME), airless
ephemeris.quantities: apparent azimuth/elevation (az from north toward east), angular diameter

meta.method: Every terrain point gets its own horizon (great circles, curvature, rays to 80/160 km) 1 m above the ground; the browser lights a point by the share of the solar disc above that horizon (same rule as sun_frac). Inside the 5 m patch the browser also marches toward the Sun over the 5 m heights.
meta.limits: Horizon maps are sampled every 80 m (inner) / 600 m (outer) and 5 or 10 deg of azimuth; nothing under the DEM resolution is drawn; no synthetic relief.
meta.si_use: Code written with Claude Code (SI) during the event; data are NASA LOLA + JPL Horizons.

patch.source: NASA PGDA shape-from-shading model, 5 m/px (LROC NAC photographs on LOLA; Bertone et al. 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17954508), +-7.5 km around the site
patch.note: SfS model: terrain detail from LROC NAC photographs where the ground is sunlit in them; LOLA elsewhere
